name: uphill
title: Uphill
description: Drive a little buggy as far as it goes over endless hills: the gas sits it back, the brake tips it forward, and in the air the same two keys lean it, so every crest is a landing to get right. Fuel cans keep you going, coins line the road, a kicker, a wall and a gap wait along the way, and the hills grow the further you get.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the engine and the sounds are; M in the game turns them off.

store.tagline: Drive as far as the fuel goes over endless hills

actions.title: Gas
actions.description: On the ground it drives and sits the car back; in the air it leans the nose up. W too.

actions.title: Brake and back up
actions.description: On the ground it brakes, then reverses, and tips the nose down; in the air it leans the nose down. S too.

actions.title: Drive again
actions.description: At any time; after a run, Space too.

actions.title: Next look
actions.description: Forest, Desert, Dusk and Classic; the choice is kept and follows you to your other machines.

actions.title: Next style
actions.description: Cartoon, Soft or Silhouette for the car, the ground and the pickups, over any look but Classic; kept like the look.

features: A real little car: a sprung chassis on two wheels, so the suspension squats on the climbs and soaks up the landings
Gas and brake lean the car in the air: land every crest on both wheels, or flip it for a bonus
Fuel runs down as you drive; the cans along the road fill the tank, each a little further on than the last
Endless hills that grow taller and bumpier the further you get, with a kicker, a wall and a gap along the way
Your best distance marked on the road with a flag, and kept on your other machines when you're signed in

screenshots.caption: A climb with the suspension squatting under it, the hills growing behind
Over the gap: the same keys that drive lean the car in the air, so you land on both wheels
The gas held through the kicker 450 m in: driver down, and how far your best went
The start: the gas, the brake and the fuel the cans along the road keep topped up
